options.content:
## Karpenter Metrics Unavailable

AKS Node Auto-Provisioning (NAP) runs Karpenter as a **managed, hidden service**. No `karpenter_*` metrics are exposed and `kube-state-metrics` is not deployed.

This dashboard infers pool membership from **node name patterns** (e.g., `aks-spot-amd64-ephemeral-*`) and uses OTel metrics as a proxy for scaling behavior.

**Tracking issues:**
- [Azure/karpenter-provider-azure#612](https://github.com/Azure/karpenter-provider-azure/issues/612) — Karpenter metrics in NAP (closed)
- [Azure/AKS#5629](https://github.com/Azure/AKS/issues/5629) — NAP node observability (open, ETA May 2026)

**When native metrics become available**, this dashboard will be updated to use `karpenter_*` metrics directly.
